title: Acute Effects of Nutrition Supplementation on Treatment Efficiency and Hemodynamics During Dialysis
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the effect of nutritional supplementation during hemodialysis treatment on beat-to-beat hemodynamics and treatment efficiency in a crossover design.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Receiving hemodialysis treatment three times per week, on hemodialysis for greater than three months, receive medical clearance from a Nephrologists

Exclusion Criteria:

* Milk or soy allergy, more than 4 hypotensive events requiring intervention in the last two weeks, hospitalized due to hypotension in the previous week
